node.statement: The convention in amended node 1.1 is an explicit construction, not an added axiom. By def-stochastic, Q has real coefficients q_ij>=0 with sum_j q_ij=1. Define Q_C:C^n->C^n by (Q_C z)_i=sum_j q_ij z_j, D_C(a)=(a_11,...,a_nn), and J_C(z)=diag(z). At matrix level identify M_r(C^n) with the direct sum over j of M_r(C). If F=(F_j)_j is positive, then (Q_C)^(r)(F)_i=sum_j q_ij F_j is positive. Also D_C^(r) sends a positive block matrix [a_st] in M_r(M_n(C)) to the tuple ([a_st(i,i)])_i of positive compressions, while J_C is a unital *-homomorphism. Thus Q_C,D_C,J_C are UCP; they are unital, so node 1.1.2 makes them completely contractive. Direct calculation gives D_C J_C=I, range(J_C Q_C D_C) diagonal, and D_C(J_C Q_C D_C)=Q_C D_C. Moreover all three maps commute with coordinatewise conjugation or adjoint on self-adjoint inputs, and Q_C restricts to the original Q on R^n. Any complex positive map sends self-adjoint elements to self-adjoint elements (apply it to the positive and negative parts), so after commutativity supplies iota_C:C^k->B, the formulas for A and M restrict to real positive unital maps R^k->R^n and R^n->R^k. Hence no map M_n(C)->R^n is being used: all UCP/cb operations occur on C^m, and only their self-adjoint restrictions occur in the stochastic conclusion.
